issue: Normal product/draft rental prices and already registered physical pieces were not connected to storefront rental discovery.
changes: Product-created rental offers are enabled by default, with public readiness and date availability still required.
Generated single-product inventory links reuse only exact product/variant/size/colour pieces from the same store across existing pools.
Untouched legacy generated drafts are repaired in bounded transactional batches at backend startup; reviewed pauses and custom bundles are preserved.
Product editor offers a rental visibility checkbox, linked quantities and setup reasons.
Physical piece cards open the exact linked product setup while preserving store scope.
Quotes, holds, calendars and accepted-inventory replacements share the matching rules; existing physical reservations prevent duplicate allocation.
Custom Studio pools and sale stock remain independent; no assets or business prices are invented.

requires: Backend startup repairs only untouched legacy generated drafts. Reviewed/paused offers require the product editor visibility checkbox.
Published rental mode, real positive rent and matching physical pieces are required; investigate Setup pending reasons for any remaining product.

countNote: Scoped follow-up counts are not added to historical full-project totals or overlapping reruns.
